title: Mega menu
description: A site header whose Resources link opens a wide panel of tiles. A tile lights up and its icon plays when you hover over it.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. Apart from three lines for the chevron, this is the whole script.

fragments.title: The Resources button
fragments.note: The browser opens and closes the panel; the chevron turns with it.

fragments.title: Keep aria-expanded in step
fragments.note: One listener writes the panel's state onto the button, where the chevron can follow it.

fragments.title: A tile
fragments.note: Hovering anywhere on a tile plays its icon.

fragments.title: Light up the whole tile
fragments.note: The same look for the pointer and the keyboard.

fragments.title: Slide down from under the header
fragments.note: CSS alone animates the panel in and out, with transform only, so it stays smooth.

fragments.title: Rows that drop in
fragments.note: The tiles keep settling for a moment after the sheet has stopped.
